# NotificationItem

`NotificationItem` — one row for an update that arrived over time, shared by the Inbox, a Home card and a full notifications page. The whole row is a single link (`href`). When `unread` is true, the row shows the selected fill and an unread dot paired with the visually hidden word "Unread" so assistive technology announces it. When `onMarkRead` is also passed, a compact "Mark as read" `IconButton` sits as a sibling of the link over the trailing slot and appears on hover and keyboard focus. Anatomy (`__start`, `__body` [`__label`, `__description`], `__end`) matches `FileItem` and `SettingRow` so all three can lift onto a shared row base.

## Usage

Use `NotificationItem` for updates that arrived over time: in the Inbox Notifications panel, in a recent-updates card on Home, or on a full notifications page. Every row says who, what, where and when in two compact lines and opens its destination as one link.

## Motion

NotificationItem reads these motion tokens and no literal duration or curve.

| Event | Transition | Tokens | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| change | Update a value or state | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Row fill and Mark as read fade on hover, press and read state changes. |

## Alternatives

- For a passing confirmation of an action that just finished, use `Flag`.
- For something to read or act on inside part of a page, use `SectionMessage`.
- For a condition that holds across a whole surface, use `Banner`.

## Best practices

### Keep the whole row a single link. {#keep-the-whole-row-a-single-link}

Put the destination on `href` and never nest links inside `title` or `meta`. A single link gives one clear target for pointers and one stop per row for keyboard users.

Do: One link opens the session; Mark as read sits beside it as a sibling button.
Don't: Missing actor name and context forces opening the notification to tell who and where.

### Pair Avatar for people and Tile for the system. {#pair-avatar-for-people-and-tile-for-the-system}

Circles represent people; rounded squares represent tools, reminders and system events.

Do: System reminder uses a 32px Tile so people and automated events scan apart.
Don't: Person Avatar initials on an automated system reminder.

## Accessibility

- **One link per row.** `NotificationItem` renders a single `<a>` element for the row and keeps the `"Mark as read"` `IconButton` as a sibling outside the link so interactive controls never nest.
- **Unread state announced in words.** The unread dot is `aria-hidden="true"` and paired with visually hidden `"Unread"` inside the link, so assistive technology announces unread status without relying on color or shape.
- **No duplicate actor announcement.** `actor` sits in an `aria-hidden="true"` start slot because `title` names who acted.
- **Keyboard-reachable Mark as read.** Focusing the row link triggers `:focus-within`, revealing `"Mark as read"` as the next Tab stop.

## Related

- Notifications: use when choosing between a Flag, Banner, SectionMessage, Modal or the Inbox.
- `Avatar`: use when a person triggered the notification (`actor`).
- `Tile`: use when the system triggered the notification (`actor`).
- `EmptyState`: use when all unread items in the Inbox have been cleared.

Same group: `Banner` · `EmptyState` · `Flag` · `InlineMessage` · `Modal` · `SectionMessage` · `Spotlight`

## Parts

1. **Actor (`actor` at `start`).** A `32px` (`--image-md`) `Avatar` for a person or `Tile` for the system. Hidden from the link's accessible name because `title` already says who acted.
2. **Title (`title` at `label`).** Who and what on `--body-default` in `--ds-text`, promoted to `--type-weight-medium` while `unread` is true.
3. **Meta (`meta` at `description`).** Context and relative time separated by a middle dot (`"Sessions · 2m"`) on `--body-small` in `--ds-text-subtle`.
4. **Unread indicator and action (`end`).** An `8px` (`--count-tag-dot-size`) dot in `--ds-background-brand-bold` paired with visually hidden `"Unread"`, replaced on hover and keyboard focus by a compact `"Mark as read"` `IconButton` when `onMarkRead` is provided.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Unread | `--ds-background-selected` fill, `--type-weight-medium` title, `--ds-background-brand-bold` dot, and `Unread` announced in the link name. |
| Read | `--ds-background-neutral-subtle` fill, regular title weight, no dot and no `Mark as read` button. |
| Hovered | `--ds-background-selected-hovered` (unread) or `--ds-background-neutral-subtle-hovered` (read); on actionable unread rows the dot hides and `Mark as read` appears. |
| Focused | 2px `--ds-border-focused` ring on the row link, with `Mark as read` visible and reachable on the next Tab press. |
| Pressed | `--ds-background-selected-pressed` (unread) or `--ds-background-neutral-subtle-pressed` (read). |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Row padding, gap and radius | `--pad-y-lg` × `--pad-x-md`, gap `--inline-lg`, radius `--radius-control-md`. |
| Row state fills | `--ds-background-selected` / `-hovered` / `-pressed` when unread; `--ds-background-neutral-subtle` / `-hovered` / `-pressed` when read. |
| Actor and trailing slots | `--image-md` (`32px`) start slot; `--control-sm` (`24px`) end slot with `--count-tag-dot-size` (`8px`) dot in `--ds-background-brand-bold`. |
| Title and meta | `--body-default` (`--type-weight-medium` when unread) in `--ds-text`; `--body-small` in `--ds-text-subtle`; stack gap `--stack-sm`. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Say who and what in `title`: "Ana Ruiz moved Thursday's session". | "New update" or "Session notification". |
| Pair where and when in `meta`: "Sessions · 2m", "Notes · Yesterday". | Full timestamps down to the second on every row. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `actor` | node | — | Leading actor visual: an `Avatar` for a person or a `Tile` for the system. Hidden from the link's accessible name because `title` names who acted. |
| `title` | node (required) | — | Who did what, such as `"Ana Ruiz moved Thursday's session"`. |
| `meta` | node | — | Context and relative time on one line, such as `"Sessions · 2m"`. |
| `unread` | bool | `false` | Marks the row unread with the selected fill, an unread dot and an announced `"Unread"` state. |
| `href` | string | `'#'` | Destination URL for the notification row. |
| `onMarkRead` | func | — | Called when the user activates the `"Mark as read"` button on an unread item. |
| `onClick` | func | — | Click handler forwarded to the row link. |
| `onPointerEnter` | func | — | Pointer-enter handler on the row container. |
| `onPointerLeave` | func | — | Pointer-leave handler on the row container. |
| `id` | string | — | Optional `id` on the row container. |
| `className` | string | — | Extra class names on the row container. |
| `style` | object | — | Inline style on the row container. |
| `testId` | string | — | Maps to `data-testid` on the row container. |
